source_span.text: Cyber Security Engineer
DoD Risk Management Framework
System Security Plans (SSPs)
Security Assessment Reports (SARs)
Risk Assessments
Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms)
Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs)
Analyze vulnerability scans and ensure timely mitigation or acceptance of risks
Support security incident response and forensics analysis
DoD 8570.01-M IASAE Level II certifications: CISSP, CISSP-ISSAP, CISSP-ISSEP, CSSLP, or CASP+ CE
Developer experience is preferred in a least one scripting / programming language
Ability to architect, design, troubleshoot, maintain, and deploy vulnerability scanning solutions
Strong in-depth understanding of including Microsoft Windows and Linux/UNIX operating systems
Experience with middleware / web technologies (Apache, tomcat, IIS, etc.)
Understanding of TCP/IP networking
Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery Platforms
Familiar with NIST 800-171, 800-172, NIST SSDF, and CMMC requirements
Lead the integration of RMF activities into the system development lifecycle (SDLC)
Develop and maintain key security documentation such as System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), Risk Assessments, and Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms)
selecting, implementing, and validating security controls
ensure that security is integrated into system design, development, testing, and deployment and that all security requirements are compliant with the DoD Risk Management Framework
Experience establishing a System Security Engineering management process to integrate security and privacy controls into complex hardware and software systems

source_span.text: The Kayenne program is seeking a Cyber Security Engineer technical lead for the Program’s Cyber Team. This team is responsible for applying an interdisciplinary, collaborative approach to plan, design, develop, validate and verify Cyber solutions across the lifecycle.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Lead the Cyber Team in planning, designing, developing, validating, and verifying Cyber solutions across the lifecycle.

source_span.text: The desired candidate will be able to conduct cyber risk assessment activities including threat modeling, vulnerability analysis and analysis of mitigation solutions.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Conduct cyber risk assessment activities including threat modeling, vulnerability analysis, and mitigation solution analysis.

source_span.text: They will also evaluate and analyze design constrains, trade-offs and detailed system and security design as they pertain to the Cyber domain.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Evaluate and analyze design constraints, trade-offs, and detailed system and security design related to the Cyber domain.

source_span.text: Furthermore, they will conduct cybersecurity test and evaluation of hardware and/or software designs to verify and validate compliance with defined specifications and requirements,

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Conduct cybersecurity test and evaluation of hardware and software designs to verify compliance with specifications and requirements.

source_span.text: and employ cyber security processes, methods, techniques and tools and assure their consistent application.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Employ cybersecurity processes, methods, techniques, and tools ensuring their consistent application.

source_span.text: Finally, they will implement appropriate Assessment and Authorization activities as required by customers.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Implement Assessment and Authorization activities as required by customers.

source_span.text: As the Cyber System Security Engineer, you will work with multiple teams across the Kayenne program in an Agile team environment. You will interface with our Operations, Development, Deployment, and Systems Engineering teams, and will help to derive innovative solutions to complex technical problems to provide our customers with a secure system and new capabilities.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Collaborate across multiple teams and stakeholders to derive innovative solutions for secure systems and new capabilities.

source_span.text: Security Design and Architecture • STIG Hardening Guidance • Security Tool Design and System integration Support

tasks.task_description: design and build clinical NLP systems

source_span.text: development and novel application of NLP and large language models to extract insights from unstructured clinical text using techniques such as named entity recognition (NER), negation detection, structured data extraction, diagnosis prediction, risk stratification, temporal reasoning and phenotyping

tasks.task_description: extract insights from unstructured clinical text using NLP techniques

source_span.text: designing, implementing, rigorously evaluating, deploying and maintaining robust and scalable NLP pipelines and models to extract meaningful information from unstructured clinical text in secure environments

tasks.task_description: design, implement, evaluate, deploy and maintain NLP pipelines and models

source_span.text: Experience with large language models - such as fine-tuning, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and adapting foundation models for domain-specific clinical tasks

tasks.task_description: fine-tune and adapt large language models for clinical tasks

source_span.text: The clinical NLP RSE will work closely with clinicians, informatics researchers, data scientists and other RSEs to ensure NLP systems meet application goals with methodological rigor and scientific reproducibility

multi-cloud expertise
Provision, configure, and maintain cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents, performance issues, and service outages in production and staging environments.
Lead root cause analysis and post-mortem documentation for major incidents.
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM, or OCI Resource Manager.
Ensure adherence to security best practices, including least-privilege access, encryption, and network segmentation.
Implement and manage identity and access management (IAM) policies and roles.
Support compliance efforts related to customer and regulatory requirements (TxRAMP, ISO, SOC2, etc.).
Recommend and implement cost optimization, resource utilization, and rightsizing strategies.
Use scripting (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) to automate repetitive tasks and operational processes.
Expert in ServiceNow ITSM

Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to ensure high availability and reliability.
Deep hands-on knowledge in architecture, deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting in major public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI).
Experience with CI/CD pipelines
Administration of compute, storage, networking, database, and PaaS services across supported platforms.
Strong understanding of backup strategy, disaster recovery, and high-availability architecture.

source_span.text: The AWS Cloud Engineer is responsible for advanced technical support, administration, and optimization of managed customer cloud environments spanning AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Own advanced technical support, administration, and optimization of managed customer cloud environments across multiple public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI).

source_span.text: Cloud Operations & Support Provision, configure, and maintain cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents, performance issues, and service outages in production and staging environments. Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to ensure high availability and reliability. Lead root cause analysis and post-mortem documentation for major incidents. Execute patch management, upgrades, and regular maintenance activities. Develop and maintain backup, disaster recovery, and failover strategies and operations.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Lead cloud operations including provisioning, configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, incident resolution, patch management, and disaster recovery strategies for cloud infrastructure.

source_span.text: Automation & Infrastructure Management Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM, or OCI Resource Manager. Use scripting (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) to automate repetitive tasks and operational processes. Champion the use of configuration management tools and assist in DevOps pipeline integrations.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Develop and maintain automation and infrastructure as code (IaC) templates and scripts to support cloud infrastructure management and DevOps pipeline integration.

source_span.text: Security & Compliance Ensure adherence to security best practices, including least-privilege access, encryption, and network segmentation. Implement and manage identity and access management (IAM) policies and roles. Monitor, identify, and remediate security vulnerabilities reported by scanning tools or external advisories. Support compliance efforts related to customer and regulatory requirements (TxRAMP, ISO, SOC2, etc.).

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Ensure security and compliance of cloud environments by implementing best practices, managing IAM policies, monitoring vulnerabilities, and supporting regulatory compliance efforts.

source_span.text: Collaboration & Documentation Work closely with application, security, and network teams for solution delivery and support. Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance as needed. Create and update technical documentation, runbooks, and SOPs. Participate in client calls to provide technical input when required.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor junior engineers, and maintain technical documentation to support cloud solution delivery and operations.

source_span.text: cloud operations and implementation
Cloud experience in Azure (required)
Must have terraform experience
Experience with AI tools
5 years of experience in a technical support position
Experience with scripting technologies such as Bash, Terraform, PowerShell, Ansible, Bicep or Azure Command Line Interface
Experience with server virtualization technologies and their support technologies (e.g., Azure Stack HCI, VMware, Hyper-V, VRealize, SRM)
Experience in an Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) services framework
Demonstrated ability to write, debug, and maintain Infrastructure as code (IaC), PowerShell and Azure CLI scripts
Understanding of Azure networking services, including Virtual Networks, Azure Gateways, Azure vWan, S2S VPN and Azure ExpressRoute
Knowledge of source control management, preferably with Git, and familiarity with branching strategies
Understanding of cloud security principles and hands-on experience with Azure security tools like Azure Security Center, Azure Key Vault, Purview and Azure Firewall
Ability to analyze and optimize cloud costs, using Azure Cost Management, billing or third-party tools
Strong knowledge of Active Directory, EntraID, and other Windows server services
Strong knowledge of Linux and AIX distributions
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
Strong documentation skills

Lead technical engagements with prospective and existing customers, acting as the primary solution consultant, technical advisor, and embedded engineer for agentic AI and agent system deployments.

tasks.task_description: lead technical engagements with customers

source_span.text: Partner directly with customer stakeholders—from clinical operations, data science, and IT teams to C-level executives—to scope requirements and deploy agentic AI systems that enable autonomous clinical development workflows with built-in human oversight.

tasks.task_description: partner with customer stakeholders to scope requirements and deploy agentic AI systems

source_span.text: Design, architect, and implement tailored solutions integrating Medable’s platform with eClinical systems (EDC, eCOA, CTMS, RTSM/IWRS), enterprise environments, and agentic AI frameworks to build autonomous systems powered by agent systems for end-to-end trial automation.

tasks.task_description: design, architect, and implement tailored solutions integrating Medable’s platform with eClinical systems and agentic AI frameworks

source_span.text: Demonstrate Medable capabilities through live demos, technical deep dives, proof-of-concepts, and production deployments of agentic AI, showcasing autonomous agents, reasoning loops, multi-agent orchestration, and goal-driven adaptation in clinical contexts.

tasks.task_description: demonstrate Medable capabilities through demos and deployments of agentic AI

source_span.text: Build, deploy, and optimize agentic AI and agent systems in regulated environments, enabling autonomous capabilities such as real-time patient matching, adaptive protocol execution, predictive risk mitigation, automated data reconciliation, and trial simulation—while enforcing human-in-the-loop safeguards (supervision loops, safety gates, audit trails, and escalation protocols).

tasks.task_description: build, deploy, and optimize agentic AI and agent systems in regulated environments

source_span.text: Incorporate robust human-in-the-loop systems throughout agentic deployments, including intervention points, validation workflows, and hybrid decision-making to maintain compliance, ethical standards, and human accountability in autonomous clinical operations.

tasks.task_description: incorporate human-in-the-loop systems to maintain compliance and accountability

source_span.text: Wrangle large-scale clinical, real-world, and operational data to power agentic AI reasoning and agent coordination, accelerating autonomous insights while ensuring seamless integration with human review processes.

tasks.task_description: wrangle large-scale clinical and operational data to power agentic AI reasoning

source_span.text: Develop custom integrations, APIs, configurations, and tooling to support agentic AI autonomy and agent system interoperability, addressing customer-specific needs like decentralized trial flows or adaptive designs.

tasks.task_description: develop custom integrations, APIs, configurations, and tooling for agentic AI autonomy

source_span.text: Troubleshoot and refine agentic AI deployments on-site or remotely, optimizing for scalability, reliability, low-latency reasoning, and effective human-AI collaboration in production clinical environments.

tasks.task_description: troubleshoot and refine agentic AI deployments on-site or remotely

source_span.text: Collaborate with product, engineering, and go-to-market teams to relay field insights from agentic AI deployments, prioritizing features for autonomous clinical systems with human safeguards, and influencing roadmap decisions.

tasks.task_description: collaborate with product, engineering, and go-to-market teams to relay field insights

source_span.text: Contribute to RFPs, technical proposals, solution designs, and executive presentations highlighting the transformative impact of agentic AI and agent systems in enabling autonomous yet compliant clinical development.

tasks.task_description: contribute to RFPs, technical proposals, solution designs, and executive presentations

source_span.text: Drive adoption, quantify impact (e.g., reduced enrollment timelines, minimized protocol deviations, improved data integrity), and expand customer relationships to support revenue growth and sustained success.

tasks.task_description: drive adoption, quantify impact, and expand customer relationships

Understanding of SRE principles including SLIs/SLOs/SLAs, error budgets, incident management, and blameless postmortems

source_span.text: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) role owns reliability outcomes for factory digital systems
Platform Engineering Design and evolve reliable, scalable, and secure platform foundations
Observability Raise the bar on end‑to‑end telemetry for factory systems

Design and evolve reliable, scalable, and secure platform foundations across hybrid/on‑prem factory environments (e.g., Kubernetes/EKS, vSphere/ESXi, Linux/Windows server, industrial PCs), with clear reliability and cost guardrails.

tasks.task_description: Design and evolve reliable, scalable, and secure platform foundations

source_span.text: Codify production‑readiness standards and guardrails for factory systems (health checks, runbooks, SLOs/SLIs, deployment safety, failover patterns) aligned to Platform’s production readiness checklist.

tasks.task_description: Codify production‑readiness standards and guardrails for factory systems

source_span.text: Advance Infrastructure‑as‑Code and configuration automation (e.g., Terraform/Terragrunt, Ansible) for factory workloads, including provisioning, secrets, policies, and change safety.

tasks.task_description: Advance Infrastructure‑as‑Code and configuration automation for factory workloads

source_span.text: Partner with Manufacturing Engineering, Factory IT, Security, and Networking to land pragmatic, operable designs; contribute to reference architectures and reusable patterns.

tasks.task_description: Partner with Manufacturing Engineering, Factory IT, Security, and Networking to land pragmatic, operable designs

source_span.text: Lead or contribute to reliability initiatives (e.g., self‑healing automation, safe rollouts/canaries, rollback strategies) appropriate to level.

tasks.task_description: Lead or contribute to reliability initiatives

source_span.text: Raise the bar on end‑to‑end telemetry for factory systems: high‑signal metrics, logs, traces, and SLO‑driven alerts (e.g., Prometheus/Grafana, Loki/Tempo, Datadog, Splunk).

tasks.task_description: Raise the bar on end‑to‑end telemetry for factory systems

source_span.text: Establish consistent dashboards and service health views for shop/line‑level systems, including exporters for hypervisor/VM health and plant endpoints where feasible (e.g., vSphere exporters).

tasks.task_description: Establish consistent dashboards and service health views for shop/line‑level systems

source_span.text: Improve alert quality and ownership: reduce noise, align escalation policies, and ensure actionable runbooks and health checks for critical services.

tasks.task_description: Improve alert quality and ownership

source_span.text: Build internal tooling (CLI/SDKs, operators/controllers, remediation bots) that turns telemetry into prevention and rapid response.

tasks.task_description: Build internal tooling that turns telemetry into prevention and rapid response

source_span.text: Act as technical incident responder for factory‑impacting events; lead fast triage, stabilize services.

tasks.task_description: Act as technical incident responder for factory‑impacting events

source_span.text: Drive post‑incident reviews that eliminate repeat failure modes; improve MTTR and availability through durable engineering fixes and process improvements.

tasks.task_description: Drive post‑incident reviews to eliminate repeat failure modes

source_span.text: Drill on‑call readiness, escalation policies, and schedules using established incident tooling and practices (e.g., Rootly/alternatives), tuned for 24x7 manufacturing operations.

tasks.task_description: Drill on‑call readiness, escalation policies, and schedules

source_span.text: Mentor peers through reliability deep dives, failover exercises, and simulation runbooks (breadth of mentorship scales with level).

tasks.task_description: Mentor peers through reliability deep dives, failover exercises, and simulation runbooks

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Architect, design, and build the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) foundation from the ground up, including defining SRE processes, selecting technologies, and creating frameworks to ensure system reliability, scalability, and performance

source_span.text: Build SRE practices from scratch - define SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and reliability metrics • Establish incident response procedures, on-call rotations, and post-mortem processes • Create reliability engineering standards and best practices across all engineering teams • Develop disaster recovery and business continuity strategies

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Establish and develop SRE practices such as defining SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, reliability metrics, incident response procedures, on-call rotations, post-mortem processes, and disaster recovery strategies

source_span.text: Drive architecture decisions for comprehensive application and infrastructure monitoring solutions • Design and develop custom SRE tools for automated monitoring, alerting, and remediation • Build observability platforms that provide deep insights into system performance and user experience • Create automation frameworks for deployment, scaling, and incident response • Architect logging, metrics, and tracing systems for distributed microservices environments

experience working with modern data tools (dbt, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar)

Cross-functional communication — can partner with non-technical stakeholders to understand needs, triage issues, and drive adoption

can validate query logic and troubleshoot issues independently

Build and maintain context infrastructure: Translate institutional business knowledge into structured formats — business glossaries, DBT model enrichment, semantic layer definitions in Omni Analytics — so that AI tools can answer questions accurately, not just confidently.

tasks.task_description: Build and maintain context infrastructure

source_span.text: Design and run evaluation frameworks: Develop predefined test cases, accuracy benchmarks, and validation workflows that measure whether AI-generated insights are trustworthy. Own the feedback loop between eval results and context improvements.

tasks.task_description: Design and run evaluation frameworks

source_span.text: Build and orchestrate AI agent systems: Help design, build, and iterate on the agent architectures that power our analytics tools — including prompt pipelines, tool orchestration, query routing logic, and guardrails that determine when AI should answer autonomously vs. escalate for human validation.

tasks.task_description: Build and orchestrate AI agent systems

source_span.text: Experiment and evaluate: Test prompt configurations, agent behaviors, and model outputs across different use cases — using eval results and accuracy metrics to drive continuous improvement.

tasks.task_description: Experiment and evaluate AI prompt configurations and model outputs

source_span.text: Develop internal AI tooling and workflows: Build tools and automations that improve DS&A's own efficiency — identifying opportunities where AI can accelerate the team's work and executing on them.

tasks.task_description: Develop internal AI tooling and workflows

source_span.text: Leveraging knowledge of change management proven practices and/or involving the change management team, proactively helps the customer deploy for long-term organizational adoption to increase customer satisfaction and drive consumption/usage.

tasks.task_description: help customers deploy for long-term organizational adoption

source_span.text: Guides complex customers/partners towards a well-architected (e.g., secure, resilient, artificial intelligence [AI]-enabled), and cost- and performance-optimized solution to increase retention and expansion opportunities.

tasks.task_description: guide customers towards well-architected AI-enabled solutions

source_span.text: Articulates the value of Unified and supports sellers, partnering with account teams to build consumption plans aligned with appropriate services.

tasks.task_description: articulate value of Unified and support sellers

source_span.text: Provides feedback to Unified Delivery Team on VBDs to refine and further develop content.

tasks.task_description: provide feedback to Unified Delivery Team on VBDs

source_span.text: Proactively identifies and anticipates new cross-solution opportunities for Consumption, Usage & Unified expansion (especially Enhanced Solutions) at scale based on business value to customer/partner and clear understanding of the Microsoft value proposition for supported platforms to empower cloud success, foster and strengthen security and resiliency, and drive AI innovation.

tasks.task_description: identify and anticipate cross-solution opportunities for expansion

source_span.text: Strategically consults with, actively listens to, and respectfully challenges customers/partners, building trust to then advocate for alternative architectures/solutions/approaches that shape and/or enhance customer requirements.

tasks.task_description: strategically consult with and challenge customers/partners

source_span.text: Identifies, anticipates, and evaluates industry trends (e.g., customer industry verticals, information technology [IT] industry), gathers customer/partner insights (e.g., feedback around technical preferences, environments, business needs, competitive landscape), and maps both existing and novel architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business outcomes.

tasks.task_description: identify and evaluate industry trends and customer insights

source_span.text: Proactively anticipates and captures opportunities in appropriate systems, processes, and tools, working collaboratively across the organization to execute on opportunities aligned with Microsoft's Customer Engagement Model.

tasks.task_description: capture opportunities and execute aligned with Customer Engagement Model

source_span.text: Anticipates, identifies, escalates, and mitigates blockers using appropriate tools and processes to accelerate solution deployment, value realization and usage/consumption for complex customers/scenarios.

tasks.task_description: identify, escalate, and mitigate blockers to accelerate deployment

source_span.text: Proactively applies broad business, technical, industry, and/or enterprise knowledge to architecture or support projects to meet business and information technology (IT) requirements and resolve identified constraints.

tasks.task_description: apply broad knowledge to meet business and IT requirements

source_span.text: Operates according to required operational excellence and proven practice standards throughout all sales stages/activities/tools of record (e.g., pipeline updates, time tracking).

tasks.task_description: operate according to operational excellence and proven standards

source_span.text: Orchestrates and collaborates across Microsoft and customer/partner teams through on-strategy delivery to achieve customer/partner objectives and increase customer/partner satisfaction.

tasks.task_description: orchestrate and collaborate across teams to achieve objectives

source_span.text: Proactively anticipates and manages business and technical risks, adapts methodology and applies governance principles to identify, communicate, and minimize business and technical risks.

tasks.task_description: anticipate and manage business and technical risks

source_span.text: Executes work in compliance with industry and Microsoft guidelines and procedures.

tasks.task_description: execute work in compliance with guidelines and procedures

source_span.text: Continuously prioritizes among competing demands in their work and identifies where impact occurs with customers, ensuring alignment with business priorities and goals.

tasks.task_description: prioritize competing demands and align with business goals

source_span.text: Proactively identifies and/or translates customer/partner problems into industry solutions aligned with Microsoft product and platform strategy, creates or improves an existing business model, and explains why and/or how they meet customer/partner outcomes and return on investment (ROI) goals (e.g., via proof of concept, minimally viable product [MVP], rapid prototype) relative to competitive offerings.

tasks.task_description: translate customer problems into industry solutions

source_span.text: Proactively helps the customer/partner accelerate their adoption and use of Microsoft product/platform strategy-aligned (cross-solution area) solutions.

tasks.task_description: help customers accelerate adoption of Microsoft solutions

source_span.text: Builds relationships with, and provides direction to technical decision makers (TDMs) up to the C-suite level, and builds the bridge between TDMs and business decision makers (BDMs).

tasks.task_description: build relationships and provide direction to technical decision makers

source_span.text: Leads and elevates interactions as needed with customers/partners' Chief Information Office (CIO), Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), and other C-level (CXO) roles to bridge understanding of security, compliance, operational and risk requirements across BDMs, TDMs, CIO and CISO teams, appropriately engaging additional subject matter experts when deeper expertise is required.

tasks.task_description: lead interactions with CIO, CISO, and other C-level roles

source_span.text: Proactively acts as the voice of the customer/partner, sharing ideas, feedback, insights, success stories and strategic/technical input with Engineering teams, Product Offerings teams and internal communities leveraging relevant insights from feedback tools and systems.

tasks.task_description: act as voice of customer sharing feedback with internal teams

source_span.text: Identifies and aggregates patterns of feedback across customers/partners/territories/industries, and leverages them with relevant industry perspective to develop strategic and actionable insights.

tasks.task_description: identify and aggregate feedback patterns to develop insights

source_span.text: Presents business cases to program managers to advocate for and influence product roadmaps, decision making, and bug fix prioritization, and own and drive initiatives as appropriate.

tasks.task_description: present business cases to influence product roadmaps

source_span.text: Drives self and guides other team members to focus on customer/partner experience through efficient delivery and ensuring a seamless and connected customer experience.

tasks.task_description: drive focus on customer experience and seamless delivery

source_span.text: Anticipates, addresses, and leads customer confidence calls to resolve customer/partner dissatisfaction and unmet needs, and creates and executes strategies to improve customer experience, value realization, and acceleration of transformation.

tasks.task_description: lead customer confidence calls to resolve dissatisfaction

source_span.text: Identifies and prioritizes opportunities aligned with revenue goals and orchestrates the growth of the solution utilization pipeline with partners.

tasks.task_description: identify and prioritize opportunities aligned with revenue goals

source_span.text: Provides support to partner and sales teams by bringing clarity to opportunities through proof-of-concept development and technical pre-sales engagement.

tasks.task_description: support partner and sales teams with proof-of-concept and pre-sales

source_span.text: Understands solution area-specific market opportunities (e.g., competitor insights) and collaborates with Global Partner Solutions (GPS) stakeholders to lead and execute initiatives that translate opportunities into actionable plans.

tasks.task_description: collaborate with Global Partner Solutions to execute initiatives

source_span.text: Proactively guides and supports partners in developing repeatable offerings, practices, products, and solutions, and advises partners through initial strategic customer implementations.

tasks.task_description: guide and support partners in developing repeatable offerings

source_span.text: Leverages market insights and demand signals to assist leadership in identifying relevant areas in which to drive up-skilling and/or accreditations based on demand.

tasks.task_description: assist leadership in identifying up-skilling and accreditations

source_span.text: Role models technical readiness, both depth-aligned to solution area priorities and breadth-aligned to Customer Success Unit (CSU)/corporate initiatives (e.g., security, resilience, AI), and influences team to drive their own technical readiness.

tasks.task_description: role model technical readiness and influence team

source_span.text: Acts as a mentor, leading readiness and upskilling activities in the team/organization by educating colleagues on technical and non-technical concepts and sharing proven practices.

tasks.task_description: act as mentor leading readiness and upskilling activities

source_span.text: Leads, mentors, and may assemble virtual teams (v-teams) around technologies and customer/partner challenges, sharing ideas, insights, and strategic, technical input with technical teams, internal communities across the field, and the larger v-team across Microsoft using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and their context in the competitive landscape.

tasks.task_description: lead and assemble virtual teams around technologies and challenges

source_span.text: Demonstrates deep industry knowledge and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions by leading presentations and engagements with external and internal audiences (e.g., Tech Connect, Build, Ignite)

tasks.task_description: demonstrate deep industry knowledge and lead presentations

source_span.text: Contributes to and collaborates on intellectual property (IP) and proactively identifies patterns where no IP exists (e.g., CoPilot and AI scenarios) to help build scalable and repeatable models.

tasks.task_description: contribute to and collaborate on intellectual property

source_span.text: Participates in and leads external technical and non-technical community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, webcasts, blogs, hackathons) that elevate the Microsoft brand and shares learnings across internal teams.

tasks.task_description: participate in and lead external technical and non-technical events

source_span.text: Proactively identifies and anticipates gaps through delivery, communicates those gaps to and influences relevant team members and internal/external stakeholders, and connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas that drive changes and improvements to products, IP (both existing and new), technologies, and/or processes/practices that enable solutions to scale across customers.

tasks.task_description: identify and communicate gaps to drive improvements

source_span.text: Develops and contributes to modifications of Microsoft's structured frameworks and methodologies.

tasks.task_description: develop and contribute to modifications of frameworks and methodologies

source_span.text: Proactively provides thought leadership and innovation to customers/partners and internal communities at the worldwide level.

tasks.task_description: provide thought leadership and innovation worldwide

source_span.text: Build trusted relationships with IT executives and business leaders to shape their Cloud and AI strategy, acting as a technical advisor and champion for customer success.

tasks.task_description: build trusted relationships to shape Cloud and AI strategy

source_span.text: Lead and coordinate across Microsoft, partner, and customer technical teams to manage dependencies, technical risks, and delivery milestones across complex engagements.

tasks.task_description: lead and coordinate technical teams to manage risks and milestones

source_span.text: Lead architectural design sessions and guide the implementation of secure, scalable, and resilient solutions using Microsoft best practices and frameworks such as CAF and WAF.

tasks.task_description: lead architectural design sessions and guide implementation

source_span.text: Drive technical excellence across Azure workloads—particularly AI, Foundry application services, and GitHub Copilot—ensuring mission-critical workloads are optimized for performance, security, and production-scale AI readiness.

tasks.task_description: drive technical excellence across Azure workloads

source_span.text: Align technical delivery to customer success plans and consumption priorities, ensuring solutions deliver measurable business value and long-term platform adoption.

tasks.task_description: align technical delivery to customer success plans

source_span.text: Accelerate Azure consumption and customer outcomes by developing repeatable intellectual property (IP), resolving technical blockers, and providing delivery oversight for key engagements.

tasks.task_description: accelerate Azure consumption by developing repeatable IP and resolving blockers

source_span.text: Collaborate with internal teams and partners to design impactful delivery proposals and support execution.

tasks.task_description: collaborate with teams and partners to design delivery proposals

source_span.text: Translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes and executive-level messaging for senior stakeholders.

tasks.task_description: translate complex technical concepts into executive messaging

source_span.text: Contribute to Microsoft’s technical community by mentoring peers, sharing insights, and serving as a spokesperson in internal and external forums.

tasks.task_description: mentor peers and serve as spokesperson in forums

source_span.text: Maintain advanced certifications and deep technical expertise across priority workloads such as Azure AI Foundry, GitHub, and App Services.

tasks.task_description: maintain advanced certifications and deep technical expertise

source_span.text: Inspire customer innovation by helping customers adopt AI at scale and guiding them through their transformation journey.

tasks.task_description: inspire customer innovation by guiding AI adoption at scale

source_span.text: Demonstrate a growth mindset by continuously developing technical and professional skills and contributing to a culture of learning and excellence.

tasks.task_description: demonstrate growth mindset by developing skills and culture

source_span.text: Amazon Web Services is looking for a highly motivated Solutions Architect to help accelerate customer adoption.

tasks.task_description: help accelerate customer adoption

source_span.text: As an experienced technologist and key member of the Account team you will help influence customers' architectural choices across broad use cases involving security, compute, storage networking as well as advanced scenarios involving serverless, analytics, and AI/ML.

tasks.task_description: influence customers' architectural choices

source_span.text: As a part of the role, you will provide exceptional technical design guidance and thought leadership

tasks.task_description: provide technical design guidance and thought leadership

source_span.text: You will lead efforts to capture and share best-practice knowledge with the AWS solution architect community.

tasks.task_description: lead efforts to capture and share best-practice knowledge

source_span.text: You will also gain the opportunity to learn from, collaborate with, and educate some of the brightest technical minds in the industry today across the breadth of enterprise architecture.

tasks.task_description: collaborate with and educate technical minds

source_span.text: In this role, you will have the opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of Amazon Web Services within large enterprises.

tasks.task_description: shape and deliver strategy to build AWS mind share

source_span.text: Broad responsibilities will include: owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects,

Assist with the design, configuration, and deployment of automated systems and robotic modules used in CAR‑T manufacturing workflows (e.g. isolation, expansion, formulation, cryopreservation) under GMP.

tasks.task_description: assist with design, configuration, and deployment of automated systems and robotic modules

source_span.text: Support the development of system architectures, user requirements, and technical documentation (URS, DHF, traceability matrices) through data gathering, drafting, and revision.

tasks.task_description: support development of system architectures, user requirements, and technical documentation

source_span.text: Contribute to assembling and testing functional prototypes to evaluate feasibility and performance under guidance.

tasks.task_description: contribute to assembling and testing functional prototypes

source_span.text: Participate in FAT/SAT and qualification activities by performing defined test steps, capturing data, and documenting deviations.

tasks.task_description: participate in FAT/SAT and qualification activities

source_span.text: Support equipment owners by collecting performance data, documenting observations, and escalating issues appropriately.

tasks.task_description: support equipment owners by collecting performance data and documenting observations

source_span.text: Conduct initial troubleshooting following standard procedures and assist in basic root‑cause analysis across mechanical, software, vision, and control‑system components.

tasks.task_description: conduct initial troubleshooting and assist in root-cause analysis

source_span.text: Recommend small‑scale adjustments or procedural improvements based on test results and operator feedback.

tasks.task_description: recommend small-scale adjustments or procedural improvements

source_span.text: Assist vendors and senior engineers with evaluating technologies or upgrades by preparing data summaries or test inputs.

tasks.task_description: assist vendors and senior engineers with technology evaluations

source_span.text: Contribute to operational support by monitoring equipment performance, performing routine maintenance tasks, and updating logs.

tasks.task_description: contribute to operational support by monitoring equipment performance and performing routine maintenance

source_span.text: Help prepare and revise user documentation (SOPs, O&M manuals, reports) and ensure consistency with GMP expectations.

tasks.task_description: help prepare and revise user documentation ensuring GMP consistency

source_span.text: Assist with audit readiness, documentation reviews, and compliance activities.

tasks.task_description: assist with audit readiness, documentation reviews, and compliance activities

source_span.text: Support optimization of production flows by updating test data, documenting cycle times, and assisting with control‑system evaluations.

tasks.task_description: support optimization of production flows by updating test data and documenting cycle times

source_span.text: Participate in technology‑roadmap activities by completing assigned work packages such as component testing or documentation updates.

tasks.task_description: participate in technology-roadmap activities by completing assigned work packages

source_span.text: Collaborate with QA, IT, OT, facilities, and other functions to support the alignment of automation efforts across teams.

tasks.task_description: collaborate with QA, IT, OT, facilities, and other functions to align automation efforts

source_span.text: Assist in risk assessments and mitigation planning by compiling data and maintaining worksheets.

tasks.task_description: assist in risk assessments and mitigation planning by compiling data

source_span.text: As an Automation/Robotics Engineer, you will support the design, integration, and testing of automated modular systems and mobile robots, contribute to documentation, assist in troubleshooting, help coordinate process flows, and participate in verification and sterility‑assurance activities.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Support the design, integration, and testing of automated modular systems and mobile robots for CAR-T cell therapy manufacturing.

source_span.text: Support the development of system architectures, user requirements, and technical documentation (URS, DHF, traceability matrices) through data gathering, drafting, and revision.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Contribute to documentation and compliance activities including user requirements, technical documentation, and audit readiness under GMP standards.

source_span.text: Conduct initial troubleshooting following standard procedures and assist in basic root‑cause analysis across mechanical, software, vision, and control‑system components.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Assist in troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across mechanical, software, vision, and control-system components to maintain reliable automated production lines.

source_span.text: Collaborate with QA, IT, OT, facilities, and other functions to support the alignment of automation efforts across teams.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Collaborate with cross-functional teams including QA, IT, OT, and facilities to align automation efforts across teams.

source_span.text: Participate in verification and sterility‑assurance activities.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Participate in verification, qualification, and sterility-assurance activities to ensure compliance and quality of automated systems.

source_span.text: Industrial Automation and Robotics Engineer
Industrial Automation and Robotics Engineer
Support the Automation & Robotic Leader in new robotic cell integration.
Identify and propose process optimizations and improvements to robotic assets.
Define maintenance strategy for future equipment.
During specification and preliminary design phases, gather and define maintenance requirements in equipment specifications.
Manage supplier and contractor for maintenance activity.
Monitor equipment performance, and define and animate roadmap for improvements.
Conduct functional analysis of installation and provide integrator support.
Modify and qualify new robotic programs based on production need projected from dry runs and offline simulations.
Participate in design review for new robotic project installations, as well as in machine acceptance testing and all functionality tests.
Adjust machine settings, calibrate cells, and create simulations of new 3D cells.
Responsible for development and implementation of robotics automation on-site, including TS, P-FMEA, design review, offline checks, and TPT for robot scope calculation.
Validate with supplier on tooling concept, and validate 3D models.
Generate robotic work instruction for machine operation and safety.
Accompany manufacturing team in production ramp-up.
Participate in process qualification for welding, sanding, shotblasting, painting, etc.
Support maintenance team in troubleshooting.
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Automation Engineering or related field
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Automation Engineering or related field

source_span.text: Serves as a technical subject matter expert (SME) for a Platform (iOS or Android) and provides strategic technical advisory and hands-on support for the Marriott Bonvoy app towards organizational and departmental goals.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Serve as a technical subject matter expert (SME) for a Mobile Platform (iOS or Android) providing strategic technical advisory and hands-on support towards organizational and departmental goals.

source_span.text: Helps define the Target Architecture for the Platform and advises on the Mobile Platform Roadmap and priorities.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Define the Target Architecture for the Mobile Platform and advise on the Mobile Platform Roadmap and priorities.

source_span.text: Leads architecture and framework initiatives.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Lead architecture and framework initiatives for the Mobile Platform ensuring alignment with platform standards, scalability, security, and maintainability.

source_span.text: Acts as the primary technical representative for the Mobile domain on strategic initiatives, attending initiative-related forums and meetings to gather functional and non-functional requirements and provide technical input on behalf of Mobile.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Act as the primary technical representative for the Mobile domain on strategic initiatives, gathering requirements and providing technical input across Android and iOS platforms.

source_span.text: Translates requirements and outcomes from these forums into mobile application architecture and implementation approaches, ensuring alignment with platform standards, scalability, security, and long-term maintainability.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Translate initiative requirements into mobile application architecture and implementation approaches ensuring alignment with standards and long-term maintainability.

source_span.text: Serves as the key conduit between initiative stakeholders and the Mobile domain, ensuring timely and accurate communication of technical context, architectural decisions, risks, and dependencies to Android and iOS engineers, Engineering Leadership, and Product Leadership.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Serve as key conduit between initiative stakeholders and Mobile domain to communicate technical context, architectural decisions, risks, and dependencies to engineers and leadership.

source_span.text: Partners with other Principal Engineers, Engineering Directors, Enterprise Architecture and squad Tech Leads to advise on solutioning for major features and adherence to architecture and security standards - helping to solve the most complex problems while resulting in high-quality output.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Partner with Principal Engineers, Engineering Directors, Enterprise Architecture and Tech Leads to advise on solutioning for major features and adherence to architecture and security standards.

source_span.text: Performs code reviews and coaches developers. Provides recommendations for improvements around workflow, tools and standards.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Perform code reviews and coach developers to improve workflow, tools, and standards within the Mobile engineering community.

source_span.text: Leads technical discussions for cross-platform Mobile initiatives, representing Android and iOS considerations in solution design, architectural trade-offs, and execution planning.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Lead technical discussions for cross-platform Mobile initiatives representing Android and iOS considerations in solution design and execution planning.

source_span.text: Stays abreast of the platform ecosystem (e.g., Apple or Google) to remain an expert authority on OS and device capabilities and possibilities. Researches and explores other tools, solutions, frameworks, etc. and how the industry and community at large are using them.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Stay abreast of platform ecosystem developments (Apple, Google) to remain expert authority on OS and device capabilities and explore new tools and frameworks.

source_span.text: Leads proof of concepts and helps to objectively assess technologies against goals and constraints.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Lead proof of concepts and objectively assess technologies against goals and constraints to inform Mobile platform decisions.

source_span.text: Educates the mobile engineering community, internal and external.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Educate the mobile engineering community internally and externally to enhance technical expertise and knowledge sharing.

source_span.text: Works with direct reports to facilitate consistency of service delivery across client groups • Facilitates compliance with the standard set of application development tools and processes that will drive consistency and predictability throughout the SDLC for all client groups including: • SDLC standard tools and processes for both waterfall and agile development • Estimating standard tools and processes, incorporating flexibility for small and large projects • Deployment standard tools and processes

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Manage application development standards, processes, and tools to ensure consistency and predictability across client groups and SDLC methodologies.

Lead the Developer Impact team: Manage and mentor a small, nimble team of engineers dedicated to developer productivity. You’ll set the vision and direction, and keep the team focused on high-impact projects.

tasks.task_description: Lead the Developer Impact team

source_span.text: Manage and mentor a small, nimble team of engineers dedicated to developer productivity.

tasks.task_description: Manage and mentor engineers

source_span.text: Identify & Eliminate Friction: Work closely with engineers on product teams to discover pain points in their day-to-day development process. You’ll solicit feedback through surveys, shadowing, and conversations, then prioritize and address the biggest friction points to dramatically increase developer velocity across Zapier.

tasks.task_description: Identify and eliminate friction in development process

source_span.text: Champion the “Golden Path”: Collaborate with our internal platform teams to define and promote a golden path of best practices, standardized tech stacks, service templates, and frameworks. You’ll drive adoption of these standards, making it easier for engineers to do the right thing by default when building new services or features.

tasks.task_description: Collaborate to define and promote best practices and standards

source_span.text: Own Internal Documentation & Templates: Oversee Zapier’s internal developer documentation strategy, ensuring engineers have clear, discoverable guides for how we build software. Your team will maintain up-to-date service templates, example apps, and reference implementations so that starting a new project is frictionless and consistent.

tasks.task_description: Oversee internal developer documentation strategy

source_span.text: Apply AI to Developer Workflows: Explore, experiment with, and implement AI-powered tooling to solve real development challenges. This could mean integrating AI assistants into code editors or code review processes, using machine learning to optimize test pipelines, or prototyping chatbots that help developers find information faster. You’ll bring practical AI solutions to bear on our software development lifecycle.

tasks.task_description: Explore and implement AI-powered developer tooling
